scripts.deploy:nibi: node tools/sandbox-id/cli.ts && pnpm --filter "./games/*" exec nibi deploy . --server https://nibi.zingplay.dev --channel public --source --web
scripts.build: pnpm --filter "./games/*" exec nibi build . && pnpm build:web
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm theme-layers --check && pnpm pack-assets --check && pnpm check:assets && pnpm check:kit-parts
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/pack-assets/*.test.ts scripts/check-assets/*.test.ts scripts/check-kit-parts/*.test.ts scripts/kit-theme-layers/*.test.ts tools/rename-game/*.test.ts tools/sandbox-id/*.test.ts tools/launcher-qr/*.test.ts tools/update-template/*.test.ts
